key_claims.claim: The hyperdense capsule sign on noncontrast CT identifies nonacute SDH patients who benefit from middle meningeal artery embolization; patients without the sign showed no benefit.

Left ventricular entropy on cardiac MRI independently predicts major adverse cardiovascular events in acute myocarditis, adding prognostic value beyond late gadolinium enhancement and ejection fraction.
Noncontrast abbreviated MRI using LI-RADS ancillary features can detect HCC recurrence after TACE, offering a potential gadolinium-sparing surveillance option.
A multimodal AI model using retinal fundus images predicts incident atrial fibrillation with AUROC approximately 0.80, outperforming the CHARGE-AF clinical score across multiethnic cohorts.
New RECIBM criteria for bone metastasis response show stronger prognostic association with survival than existing response frameworks.
